scope: Single observational snapshot during same-tenant phase; client backends in the synthetic Meridian database; observer excluded. Not cumulative wait time or an acceptance pass.
query: SELECT state,wait_event_type,wait_event,count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() AND pid<>pg_backend_pid() AND backend_type='client backend' GROUP BY state,wait_event_type,wait_event ORDER BY count(*) DESC
